summary: The application (A1102/16TEY) to construct a new three-storey detached dwelling with rear ground floor deck, rear basement walkout, front second and third floor balconies, and a new detached garage in the rear yard at 220 Barton Avenue was refused at the Committee of Adjustment meeting held on April 16, 2018. The applicant from 220 Barton Avenue is appealing the decision of the Committee to the Toronto Local Appeal Body. The surrounding community is in support of the decision of the Committee of Adjustment. It is therefore my belief that the Committee of Adjustment appropriately refused the application and it is important that the decision is upheld.
decided: City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to attend the Toronto Local Appeal Body and to retain outside consultants as necessary, to uphold the Committee of Adjustment decision to refuse the applications at 220 Barton Avenue (A1102/16TEY).
